title: ProEtaleInverseImageComparisonCoherence
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a discrete commutative ring and, for every scheme $T$, write $
u_T^*$ for the canonical etale-to-pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. For a scheme morphism $f:U	o V$, write $f_e^*$ and $f_p^*$ for etale and pro-etale inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and $c_f:f_p^*
u_V^*\xrightarrow{\sim}
u_U^*f_e^*$ for the inverse of the unit-normalized coefficient pullback comparison. Let $i^e_T:(\mathrm{id}_T)_e^*\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ and $i^p_T:(\mathrm{id}_T)_p^*\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm{id}$ be the specified identity comparisons, and let $a^e_{f,h}:(h\circ f)_e^*\xrightarrow{\sim}f_e^*h_e^*$ and $a^p_{f,h}:(h\circ f)_p^*\xrightarrow{\sim}f_p^*h_p^*$ be the specified composition comparisons. Then $
u_T^*(i^e_T)\circ c_{\mathrm{id}_T}=i^p_T
u_T^*$, and for all $U\xrightarrow{f}V\xrightarrow{h}W$, $
u_U^*(a^e_{f,h})\circ c_{h\circ f}=(c_fh_e^*)\circ f_p^*(c_h)\circ(a^p_{f,h}
u_W^*)$, as transformations on sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules. No quasi-compactness or finiteness hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Use comparison_pullback_coherent for the lifted coefficient ring, with its unused Finite assumption removed. All comparison functors and adjunctions are definitionally the same, and comparisonCoefficientPullbackIso is definitionally the inverse of comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso. Precompose the identity equation by the invertible comparison. For composition precompose by the inverse comparison for the composite, replace the two-step inverse comparison by the existing coherence equation, and cancel each inverse with its hom, including the pair inside upperStar.map. These are the two componentwise equations stated.

theorem inverseImageComparisonCoherence
    (Λ : Type u) [CommRing Λ] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (_g : X ⟶ Y) :
    (∀ (U : Scheme.{u})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ))),
        (comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) (𝟙 U)).hom.app F ≫
          (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) U).map
            ((Etale.upperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) U).hom.app F) =
        (ProEtale.upperStarId (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) U).hom.app
          ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) U).obj F)) ∧
    (∀ {U V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V) (h : V ⟶ W)
          (F : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ))),
        (comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) (f ≫ h)).hom.app F ≫
          (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) U).map
            ((Etale.upperStarComp
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) f h).hom.app F) =
        (ProEtale.upperStarComp
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) f h).hom.app
            ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) W).obj F) ≫
          (ProEtale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) f).map
            ((comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso
              (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) h).hom.app F) ≫
          (comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) f).hom.app
              ((Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} Λ)) h).obj F))
